name: Normal / Optimal Mucosal Inspection
description: Validates steady-state insufflation at 125 kPa. In standalone mode without KR260 pump active, mucosal absorption naturally decays pressure toward 118 kPa.

name: Low Pressure Under-Inflation
description: Simulates under-inflated lumen at 110 kPa. KR260 PID should detect pressure deficit and ramp pump PWM to >60% to restore target distension.

name: Colon Wall Gas Leak & Acoustic Hiss
description: Injects an acute gas leak. STM32 generates 3 kHz acoustic hiss via Digital I2S2 (PB13/PB12/PB15) emulating MEMS mic and drains pressure at 22 kPa/s. Tests Vitis AI acoustic classifier and PID feedforward compensation.

name: Acute Over-Expansion Hazard Relief
description: Injects hazard-level pressure of 152 kPa (>150 kPa safety ceiling). Tests safety interlock triggering EMERGENCY_STOP and opening Solenoid Valve, which rapidly vents gas to ambient (101.3 kPa).

name: Tube Occlusion / Kinked Delivery Hose
description: Simulates a kinked insufflation tube: Air pump runs high, but bowel pressure stays flat at ambient (101.3 kPa). Tests KR260 occlusion timeout and clinician alert.

name: Patient Spasm / Cough Pressure Transient
description: Simulates sudden patient muscular spasm or cough causing a 145 kPa transient spike. Tests transient response and absorption decay back toward stable baseline.

name: Patient Cough Debounce & Persistent Hazard Cutoff
description: Multi-step timeline: Validates transient cough spike (<2s) tolerance followed by persistent overpressure safety shutdown.

steps.step_name: Patient spasm relaxes back to target inspection pressure
Persistent hazard overpressure trip (>150 kPa limit)
